verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships TestModel and FunctionModel for testing and development, so agents can run without calling real LLMs. A community user confirms you can mock the LLM client for testing, and Pydantic Evals runs code-defined test datasets. The coding agent adds workspace-rooted file access and an allowlisted shell, which limits its reach. However, nothing documents an isolated sandbox environment that keeps tests away from production data or services; the user would have to build that isolation themselves through dependencies and tools. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment that isolates production data, guidance on mocking tools and dependencies against non-production backends, and hands-on corroboration of sandboxed testing.
